items.title: OpenAI代理人也駭進了澳洲政府網站
items.summary: 澳洲總理Anthony Albanese周四（9/24）在紐約出席聯合國大會期間召開記者會，揭露OpenAI旗下AI代理人於6月18日未經授權進入澳洲政府的Medicare醫療統計網站，繞過網站安全限制，存取公開及非公開資料，甚至在內部伺服器寫入檔案。Albanese已親自致電OpenAI執行長Sam Altman表達嚴重關切，並宣布成立專案小組調查事件。

items.title: 駭客用3套AI工具大規模攻擊電商，竊取超過60萬筆信用卡資料
items.summary: 資安業者Gambit Security揭露一波利用AI代理發動的大規模網路攻擊，攻擊者使用3套開源AI工具鎖定線上零售商，攻擊活動從7月延續至今，Gambit Security發布報告時表示活動仍在進行。光是9月10日至15日就啟動105個攻擊專案，至少27家公司遭入侵，攻擊者還從兩家受害企業竊取超過60萬筆尚未到期的信用卡資料，並在多個電商網站植入信用卡資料竊取程式。

items.title: 外界關注ShinyHunters竊得FBI資料，路透社最新揭露其中包含負責中俄情報業務的機密人員個資
items.summary: 駭客組織ShinyHunters駭入FBI竊取個資事件持續發酵，路透社9月23日報導指出，ShinyHunters聲稱竊得的FBI資料中，包含部分敏感情報任務的人員資訊。

items.title: 中國駭客UTA0565架設假網站，搭配Chrome與Windows零時差漏洞利用鏈攻擊亞洲政府機關
items.summary: 兩週前，資安公司Proofpoint、Volexity揭露多組中國駭客串連Chrome與Windows零時差漏洞的攻擊行動，Proofpoint將利用這些弱點的工具包命名為BlueMoon，其中利用的漏洞包括：Chrome類型混淆漏洞CVE-2026-85046、沙箱逃逸漏洞CVE-2026-87491，以及Windows權限提升漏洞CVE-2026-85880。

items.title: GitLab.com流量限制改採方案分級，匿名請求降至每小時60次
items.summary: GitLab將於10月19日起調整GitLab.com流量限制，Free方案與未經驗證的請求率先套用新規則，Premium與Ultimate方案預定2027年1月跟進。未經驗證的一般網頁與API請求，單一IP位址每小時最多60次，GitLab表示，GitLab.com需求快速成長，今年平臺負載預期增加數倍，因此需要調整流量限制，因應包含自動化工具與AI代理在內的各類工作負載。

items.title: Meta發表100公克VR眼鏡，支援虛擬多螢幕與AI操作
items.summary: Meta周三（9/23）發表新一代虛擬實境眼鏡Meta VR Glasses，將原本笨重的VR頭戴裝置縮小成約100公克的眼鏡，讓使用者可隨時在眼前開啟虛擬電影院或工作空間。新產品預計2027年春季上市，售價1,299.99美元。

items.title: fix(ci): prevent missing-database errors in session creation tests (#…
items.summary: fix(ci): prevent missing-database errors in session creation tests (#156997) * test(gateway): join suite reads before nested fixture cleanup The suite projection outlives body-scoped test state and can retain an ACP metadata read after a create request has returned. Release the suite store through its existing owner before removing the nested state database. The foreign-admin rejection itself starts no shared-state worker read. Keep the production authorization path unchanged and cover the fixture ordering with a held real read that fails when the cleanup repair is removed. Refs #156551. * test(gateway): preserve fixture cleanup after read errors Use the existing ordered cleanup owner so direct read-context disposal failures cannot skip suite-store settlement or replace earlier errors. Extend the held-read regression with a disposal-failure case and retain the original failure after the suite read settles. The failure case rejects the prior sequential implementation. The final candidate passes 190 Gateway tests, four cleanup-composition checks, ten contention replays, and the complete changed-file gate on Testbox.

items.title: fix(agents): isolate ACP lifecycle imports from embedded execution
items.summary: fix(agents): isolate ACP lifecycle imports from embedded execution Main run 35948135289, job 107479345395, timed out awaiting the terminal chat event in server.acp-native-model.product.test.ts after its unchanged 30-second budget. The original 42-file shard reproduced the failure: dispatch took 33.723s while the ACP backend itself took approximately 3ms. Importing the broad attempt runtime loaded unrelated embedded and CLI execution. Move the existing ACP lifecycle, audit, and result implementation to its narrow owner and migrate ACP callers and their mocks together. Keep the same function bodies and generic command runtime exports for the real command consumer. Remove the unused tracker type re-export and keep its alias internal. Model the existing namespace-loaded command facade in Knip, naming its real Promise.all consumer. Remove its obsolete assertion allowance. No public contract, wait budget, retry, or assertion changes. Existing real Gateway coverage proves terminal chat publication. Two-CPU pressure with a CPU contender passed 20 cold product-file runs and three original 42-file CI shard replays under the two-worker dual policy. Owner/sibling proof passed 541 cases. No shared test helper changed. The current-toolchain full build passed in 1095.958s. Paired isolated cold imports fell from 11.309s to 0.378s; peak import-process RSS fell from 1248196 to 442344 KiB. Literal single-worker changed-test wall costs: dispatch 26.921s, attempt error propagation 2.017s, task lifecycle 24.520s, agent ACP 42.550s. The dispatched flow and task lifecycle tests exercise native admission; the final dispatch mock reuses the existing pure tracker factory. Independent P2 review found no actionable defects. Testbox runs: 35953409068 and current-toolchain integration 35961104900. Completed core, all 25 core-test graphs, root-test and native scripts type checks, all three export scans, and selected guards. Script lint passed 1167 files. The authorized scoped type-aware lint substitute passed core, fixture and config checks; a negative canary detected the intended unawaited Promise and was removed. Current caller integration also passed the real Gateway flow under two-CPU contention and all 249 dispatch cases.
